title: Fable 5.1 Solves the Cyphral Distich, a 370-year-old cipher
summary: A blog post and Hacker News discussion about Fable 5.1, an AI system that reportedly solved the Cyphral Distich, a 370-year-old cipher. The 1,100-point thread with over 500 comments debates the method, significance, and whether the solution is genuine or an artifact of the model's training data.
